what_it_is.prose: Garuda Aerospace Private Limited is a Chennai-based unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) manufacturer founded by Agnishwar Jayaprakash. The company is primarily focused on agricultural and surveillance drones (30+ drone types) and is IPO-bound, having raised $49.5 million across 9 funding rounds with a confidential Draft Red Herring Prospectus (DRHP) filed with the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI). MS Dhoni is the brand ambassador. The most recent funding round in April 2025 raised ₹100 crore. Garuda's counter-UAS programme is a 4-layer system announced in September 2021 by the founder to Unmanned Airspace, but no confirmed Ministry of Defence contract for the C-UAS product has been publicly announced as of August 2026. On 22 August 2025, MoS Defence Sanjay Seth inaugurated Garuda's Defence Drone Facility at Thalambur, Chennai, where 5 defence drones were launched. At Aero India 2025 in February 2025, Garuda debuted 8 drones including counter-drone products. A Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) has been signed with Bharat Electronics Limited (BEL) for indigenous UAS collaboration. The company plans to expand beyond its existing 24,000 sq ft facility with a 35,000 sq ft drone components facility.

faq.question: Is Garuda Aerospace a listed company?
faq.answer: Not yet. Garuda Aerospace is IPO-bound and has confidentially filed a Draft Red Herring Prospectus (DRHP) with SEBI. The company has raised $49.5 million across 9 funding rounds, with the most recent round in April 2025 raising ₹100 crore. MS Dhoni is the brand ambassador. The IPO timeline has not been publicly disclosed.

faq.question: Does Garuda Aerospace make counter-drone systems?
faq.answer: Garuda Aerospace has a 4-layer counter-drone system in development since September 2021, when founder-CEO Agnishwar Jayaprakash announced the programme to Unmanned Airspace. The system was showcased at Aero India 2025 in February 2025. However, no confirmed Ministry of Defence contract specifically for Garuda's C-UAS product has been publicly announced as of August 2026. The company is primarily a UAV manufacturer (agricultural and surveillance drones, 30+ drone types) with counter-UAS as a secondary R&D programme.

faq.question: What was inaugurated at Thalambur in August 2025?
faq.answer: MoS Defence Sanjay Seth inaugurated Garuda Aerospace's Defence Drone Facility at Thalambur, Chennai on 22 August 2025. At the inauguration, Garuda launched 5 defence drones. The facility represents Garuda's expansion from agricultural drones into the defence sector. The company plans a further 35,000 sq ft drone components facility beyond the existing 24,000 sq ft.
